defaults:
a kelly green soccer jersey with contrasting sleeve trim and collar, kelly green shorts, and shin guards under the socks. The kit is slightly too big — bought with room to grow. Sleeves a little long, shorts to the knee, socks not quite pulled all the way up. Clean and well kept.
CONSISTENT ACROSS THE WHOLE SET — three of these frames sit side by side on one card, so
these must be identical in every shot and are not open to interpretation:
- Socks are kelly green, matching the kit. Never white, never a different colour.
- Equipment: a plain WHITE soccer ball with black pentagon panels — no coloured panels, no patterns, no markings, no branding. The same one in every shot.
- Footwear: plain black SOCCER CLEATS — proper football boots with a studded outsole (moulded conical studs clearly visible), a low profile and a slim toe box. NOT sneakers, NOT trainers, NOT flat-soled shoes. The same pair in every shot, clean and unmarked.
